Provenance checks out: the four byte-preserved files match their claimed SHA-256 digests exactly (test_freshness_remediation_flow.py=2656a736..., test_file_format.py=199d172c..., test_manual_upload_and_preview_api.py=1113524d..., test_web_auth.py=c9c9f12c...). The BFF suite (next_boundary) exercises the candidate's own Next build against a stubbed upstream, and the real_page browser suite exercises it against the live API; missing routes therefore fail (Next 404 HTML, not JSON) rather than pass vacuously. R1-R4 defects are each repaired by a matching negative/guard: duplicate success bytes (test_success_fixtures_do_not_duplicate + _require_unique), receiptless certainty (test_receiptless_status_guard_rejects_false_certainty, test_nb7_no_receipt_never_attributes_latest_pointer), observation semantics (test_nb4_nb5_context_and_observation, test_observation_guard_rejects_ignored_freshness), diagnostic leakage (test_response_guard_rejects_raw_spread, test_nb16_dry_run_sanitizes_issue_context, test_nb6_known_issue_context_is_safe), wrong-bound preview faults (test_nb1_nb2 pinning + test_real_preflight_fault_rewrite_is_closed + RP-wrong-id/path), stale fixture omission (_land_historical_overdue + test_loaded_overdue_fixture_and_receipt), native/Docker guard (probe + HLA_ASSERT_DOCKER_ONLY + hardcoded-image fallback), error-receipt identity (test_rejected_receipt_requires_actual_source_context), build descendant cleanup (test_build_cleanup_handles_exited_leader_and_ignoring_child), optional observation mismatch (test_nb7 supplied-together check), cancellation false rejection (RP5/RP5-old-ready accept delivered|cancelled), and displayed/backend receipt identity (_browser_case's _assert_receipt_id over the live population delta). Static limitations (non-material, no candidate false-pass found): (1) the 'trimmed source name' term is only field-set-verified (test_nb1_nb2 asserts set(fields)=={file,source_asset_id,source_name} but never asserts the source_name VALUE, so a wrong or empty name would not be caught); (2) visibleAmbiguity/visiblePreviewFacts are token-family heuristics that could reject legitimate alternative prose (e.g. 'Row count: 3' fails the rows?/records? predicate; 'belong to any account' fails the belongs/cannot family), a false-negative not a false-pass; (3) the Docker fallback pins a content-addressed image (sha256:b0ab6f3c...) with --pull=never and no build/pull step, so a genuinely Docker-only host must pre-provision that exact image or the acceptance cannot execute; (4) native browser path requires pre-installed Chromium + node v20 + Playwright resolvable from the copied frontend node_modules; (5) the PopulationAudit only runs when the file is executed as __main__, and the EXPECTED_CASES parametrize id strings (including '/'-bearing ids like 'dry-run-/ingest/dry-run') were not executable here, so exact pytest auto-id equality with EXPECTED_CASES remains an unverified static assumption. None of these let a broken candidate pass; each is an infra/false-negative concern.
response.trivial_pass: Attack: candidate implements POST /sources/{source_asset_id}/upload to always return a fabricated constant receipt (e.g. {outcome:'landed', run_id:'run-1'}) while either silently uploading to the wrong source or doing nothing, and renders a stale row. REJECTED: the real_page browser suite (RP1/RP-stale/...) reads the live backend population before and after and requires len(after-before)==1, then _assert_receipt_id(steps[0].runId, actual_new_run_id) forces the displayed receipt to equal the actual new backend run id, _detail(client, actual_id, target) forces context.source_asset_id to equal the target (A/B/C), and after_rows[target].latest_run_id==actual_id plus sibling equality force the exact row to refresh with no cross-row mutation. A hardcoded run id or a wrong-target upload cannot satisfy these.
